WITH totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(articount) AS total_count
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE articount IS NOT NULL
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.zoneref,
    sf.articount,
    sf.articount::NUMERIC / t.total_count::NUMERIC AS share
  FROM scanfeatures sf
  CROSS JOIN totals t
  WHERE sf.articount IS NOT NULL
    AND t.total_count IS NOT NULL
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_val
  FROM shares
)
SELECT 
  s.zoneref,
  s.articount,
  s.share,
  s.share - a.avg_val AS diff_from_avg
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE a.avg_val IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  s.share - a.avg_val DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
